interpretations: This supplement reads frozen protocol-derived scores; it does not reveal answers, rerank recommendations, modify results or authorize promotion.
Primary Hit@k uses all 50 allocated final cases (five per class) only when all outcomes are known. Missing score/rank fields remain unknown, with bounds and a clearly labeled known-only estimate.
A known null true_rank is a genuine non-hit in the evaluation top ten, not a missing observation. Rank means/medians condition on Hit@10 and do not assign fictitious ranks to misses.
Ranking-only comparators can receive independent supported-ranking/usable judgments. Their absent full-report fact envelopes are not completeness failures.
Usable is the frozen score: at least one reviewed eligible ranked candidate and no retained hard flag for that result. Eligible candidate counts are additionally shown and do not override this score.
Declared verified/unverified/invalid fact statuses measure envelope coverage, not independent factual correctness. Missing envelope records are unknown.
Retained hard flags, exact repeated-signature counts and affected-case counts differ. Exact signature deduplication cannot prove distinct underlying causal errors.
Two initial reviews and optional source-based adjudication are AI judgments; same-model contexts are not independent human expert validation. Full-output style can reveal comparator type.
Historical true-journal matching is one outlet comparison under current-policy hypothetical-unpublished assumptions, not an acceptance probability.
Wilson intervals describe each method's binomial Hit uncertainty; overlapping intervals and wins>=losses gates do not establish statistical improvement.
Development, protocol trials, regression/retry resource stages remain separate from final accuracy. Failed distinct call attempts remain in resource counts after a successful retry.
